title: 505 — Building healthcare in India with RocketHealth's Abhineet and Ritika
summary: Sibling co-founders Abhineet and Ritika talk through building RocketHealth — a mental-health and sexual-health brand for Indian millennials and Gen Z. They cover dividing responsibility between strategy and ops, why they pivoted out of COVID care into therapy and psychiatry, and how they treat brand-building as patience and consistency rather than performance marketing.

intents.display: to hear sibling founders build a mental-health brand in india
